title: Refuse contradictory quiet Git sightings for new citation-selected evaluations
outcome: Refuse contradictory quiet Git sightings for new citation-selected evaluations
acceptance: A registered check on git-commit:X followed by an accounted same-root quiet sighting of git-commit:Y cannot let a new citation-selected evaluation declare X and seal; pre-cut and post-cut regressions name the actual source refusal.

The prospective correction preserves the recorded interpretation, canonical bytes and exact replay of all existing evaluations and completed seals; quiet content-v1 sightings remain distinct from Git identity.
Positive controls accept unchanged exact Git input and retain existing source-change, root, run, claim and evidence-cut protections.
